2026-W42.title: Enhance User Engagement in Personal Finance App
2026-W42.scenario: Our personal finance app has seen a 25% drop in daily active users over the past month, primarily due to a lack of engaging features. User feedback indicates that 40% find the app's budgeting tools cumbersome and not user-friendly, leading to increased churn among millennials.
targetObjectives: Increase daily active users by 15% within the next quarter.
Achieve a user satisfaction score of at least 4.5 out of 5 for the budgeting tools.
Reduce the drop-off rate in the budgeting feature from 60% to 30%.
constraints: Limited engineering resources with only two developers available for the next quarter.
Budget constraints cap new feature development at $50,000.
Existing app architecture limits significant UI changes without extensive refactoring.
